skillsPage.globalSkillSourceHelp: Enter a Skill source: a local Skill directory or SKILL.md, an npm package name, or a git URL. Pisper extracts only Skill resources and copies them to ~/.pisper/agent/skills for use in every project.
skillsPage.enterALocalSkillDirectorySKIL: Enter a local skill directory, SKILL.md file, npm package, or git source. Pisper imports only its skill resources.
skillsPage.noGlobalSkills: No global Skills. Import one into ~/.pisper/agent/skills.
skillsPage.noProjectSkills: This workspace has no project Skills. Add one under .pisper/skills in the current workspace.
skillsPage.noSkillPackagesAreConfiguredY: No skill packages are configured yet. After you install a skill, its source will appear here.
skillsPage.noSkillsInstalledYetUseInstal: No skills installed yet. Use “Install skill” in the upper-right to add a local directory, npm package, or git source.
skillsPage.noSkillsMatchTheCurrentFilter: No skills match the current filter.
skillsPage.addGlobalOrProjectSkill: Import a global Skill into ~/.pisper/agent/skills, or add a project Skill under .pisper/skills in the current workspace.
skillsPage.scanningSkillDirectoriesAndCo: Scanning global Skills and current project Skills
skillsPage.skillInstalledAndLoadedIntoTh: Global Skill imported and loaded into the agent runtime
skillsPage.skillsProvideInstructionsToTh: Skills provide instructions to the agent and may include executable scripts. Confirm that you trust the source.
skillsPage.thisRemovesTheSkillDirectoryI: This removes the skill directory installed by Pisper. It does not uninstall the original npm or git package.
skillsPage.useTheButtonInTheUpperRightTo: Use the button in the upper-right to install an Agent Skills-compatible skill.
